title: Video: After Dombivli, another doctor assaulted in Kalyan
content: A doctor faced alleged assault by a patient's son at a private hospital in Kalyan.  The incident occurred late Saturday night, causing panic among other patients present.  Police initially registered a non-cognisable complaint, which was later upgraded to an FIR.  This event follows a similar assault on doctors in Dombivli weeks prior.  Doctors are demanding strict action to ensure their safety and prevent future occurrences.

title: 52 hospitalised after chlorine leak at Godhani water plant in Nagpur
content: A chlorine gas incident at the Godhani water facility led to the hospitalization of fifty-two individuals, with twelve later discharged following treatment for breathing issues. Emergency response teams from OCW, NDRF, and NMC promptly addressed the leak, which stemmed from an outdated chlorine tank. Authorities are now investigating the circumstances surrounding this alarming situation.

title: ‘This India will fight and reply’: Jaiswal's comment goes viral after Fernando spat

He emphasised the importance of understanding the entire dialogue before forming opinions. The tension arose when the Indian opener was dismissed, leading to an exchange of words and a brief scuffle that required intervention. India's batting coach later remarked that Jaiswal should have kept a respectful distance from the bowler.

title: Amid protests, CM Vijay drops project for 2nd airport for Chennai at Parandur

This expansion aims to handle twenty million additional passengers annually. The fareless travel scheme for women will also be expanded to all government buses. New sites for airport development are currently under consideration and will be finalized soon.

title: Stamping of boarding passes for immigration clearance to be discontinued from Sept 1
content: From September 1, international travelers departing from India are set to benefit from a new policy that eliminates the necessity for boarding pass stamping at immigration counters. This initiative aims to enhance the efficiency of the travel process. Passengers have the option to present their boarding passes, either in electronic format or as a printed copy.

title: Amravati hospital NICU fire: CM Fadnavis orders high-level inquiry after 3 newborns die
content: Three newborns died after a fire broke out in Amravati District Women's Hospital's NICU. The blaze reportedly started following an explosion in a ventilator on the hospital's third floor. Doctors and staff quickly evacuated thirty-nine newborns from the intensive care unit. Six critically ill infants were transferred to a super-speciality hospital for care. The exact cause of the ventilator explosion and subsequent fire is still under investigation.

title: What makes September 3 important for international students in the US on F and J visas
content: On September 3, 2026, a federal court will assess arguments against a new DHS regulation that alters the existing 'duration of status' policy for international students. Opponents of the rule contend that it fosters uncertainty and adversely impacts educational institutions. The plaintiffs aim to prevent its implementation by the September 15 deadline, and the court's ruling will shape the future framework of international student visa policies.

title: Another nightclub incident hits England: Fast bowler handcuffed, detained by police

title: 20-year-old student finds 1,200-year-old gold 90 minutes into her first dig
content: In an exciting turn of events, an American archaeology student has stumbled upon a ninth-century gold artifact in Northumberland during her very first excavation. title: Alaska eradicated rats from Aleutian island; native birds surged within 2 years
content: After two hundred years of invasive rat habitation, Hawadax Island witnessed a remarkable transformation. Within just two years of their removal, native bird populations surged by over 200 percent. Seabirds previously thought extinct began to return, nesting on the island's enchanting cliffs. The restoration of the island's original name, Hawadax, marks a significant ecological achievement and sets a global benchmark for invasive species management.

title: Mark Zuckerberg’s wife Priscilla Chan’s $125 million school to shut after 10 years

content: Based in Punjab with journalistic experience of over two decades, Navjeevan Gopal is a senior journalist reporting on crucial issues such as drugs, crime, gangsters, terror and other security issues in the border state. The Punjab Police is one of his core beats. Currently an assistant editor with The Times of India in Punjab Bureau, he comes with a vast experience of over 18 years in The Indian Express, the national daily known for its investigative journalism. Gopal had started his career in journalism with the Hindustan Times as a contributor, gradually moving to The Indian Express and thereafter TOI. He also covers Punjab’s politics with his area of interests being the 104-year-old party Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). He also extensively reported on Sikh diaspora settled across the globe.
